evidence.quote: This guide assumes you are a Brex customer with admin access to your dashboard.
Sign in to dashboard.brex.com as an account admin or card admin
generate a user token from your Brex dashboard and pass it along in your API call headers
MCP clients that support OAuth will automatically initiate a browser-based authorization flow when you first connect.
account and card admins can authenticate with a Brex API token. Generate one from Settings → Developer
Brex APIs use the REST architecture
The Brex MCP server lets AI assistants interact directly with your Brex account.
Brex currently only offers a production API server at https://api.brex.com.

result.notes: Brex's REST API and its official MCP server both require the caller to already be an existing Brex business customer with account-admin or card-admin dashboard access (no public self-serve dev signup or sandbox/free tier documented). Tokens are bearer/user tokens generated from Settings > Developer; the MCP server additionally supports an OAuth2 browser authorization flow. No mention of a free trial. Buildable as an agent toolkit only for teams that already have a live Brex account with admin rights.
result.one_liner: Brex is a corporate card and spend-management platform offering a REST API and an official MCP server for account/card admins of existing Brex customers.
